extracted.intended_audience: general newspaper readers; journalists and editors
extracted.subtask_description: A transcribed front-page collection of AP and related wire reports, local notices, and editorials from a daily newspaper (World War II era). Contains news dispatches, datelines, and occasional statements of newsroom policy cited in copy.

rubrics_metrics.name: OWI coverage policy on prominent political figures
rubrics_metrics.description: OWI policy calling for quoting prominent political figures in both parties during the pre-convention campaign, and (after nominations) to cover candidates 'with absolute impartiality' because one or the other will become President.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Context in article: Elmer Davis, director, said OWI's coverage of the Bricker meeting 'was in line with OWI policy which calls for quoting prominent political figures in both parties during the pre-convention campaign.' Overseas Director Robert E. Sherwood is quoted that after the nominations OWI's policy will be to cover candidates with 'absolute impartiality' for overseas dispatches.
